description: A fork of AutoDeafen (by Lynxdeer) with persistent key caching, StartPos auto-off, undeafen on restart/leave, and an in-level Advanced settings menu.
name: Better AutoDeafen

default_enabled.name: Enabled By Default
default_enabled.description: Whether Better AutoDeafen is <co>enabled by default</c> when you load into a level for the first time.

default_percentage.name: Default Percentage
default_percentage.description: The <co>default percentage to deafen at</c> when you load into a level for the first time.

practice.name: Enabled In Practice Mode
practice.description: Whether Better AutoDeafen should be enabled during practice mode.

disable_on_startpos.name: Disable On StartPos
disable_on_startpos.description: Automatically disables Better AutoDeafen while playing from a <cj>StartPos</c>.

undeafen_on_pause.name: Undeafen On Pause
undeafen_on_pause.description: Automatically undeafens when you pause mid-run and re-deafens when you resume.

undeafen_delay.name: Death/Win Undeafen Delay (s)
undeafen_delay.description: Optional delay in seconds before undeafening after you die or beat a level.

mute_only.name: Mute-Only Mode
mute_only.description: Mutes your Discord microphone instead of full deafen so you can still hear your friends.

near_pb_mode.name: Near Personal Best Mode
near_pb_mode.description: Automatically deafens when you get within <cg>PB Offset %</c> of your personal best on uncompleted levels.

pb_offset.name: Personal Best Offset (%)
pb_offset.description: How many percent before your Personal Best to deafen when <cg>Near Personal Best Mode</c> is enabled.

show_indicator.name: On-Screen Status Indicator
show_indicator.description: Shows a small unobtrusive status label in the top-left corner while playing.

undeafen_on_exit.name: Undeafen On Game Exit
undeafen_on_exit.description: Automatically undeafens if you close Geometry Dash while deafened.
